[LSER.6.7.1] Referencing any cursor form — `t.mean`,
`t.recent.mean`, `mean(t.recent)` — on a binding whose
schema has no declared observation covering the (slot, label,
aggregation) triple is a compile error naming the missing
declaration ([LSER.6.9.4]). One way to introduce a series, one way to
reference it; no hidden generation.
